scope: Independent source identity/allconditions/donor overlap, assay interpretation and publication value of a newly proposed public circulating-burden gate; no numerical case biomarkers inspected.
question: Can a genuinely new public, case-linked serial tumor-specific measurement, with same-donor disease burden and treatment/sample timing, answer a useful unanswered EMC monitoring contrast beyond prior published total-cfDNA decline or a single diagnostic measurement?
source_selection: Owner-cached ordinary primary routes for pending Tsoi2021Other12/SuppTableii, Bui2023all30trial roster, AndersonPMID38905450allTable1 and management2024PMC11545914. No duplicate retrieval and no new search fishing.
eligibility: Exact source EMC diagnosis with molecular/pathology confidence preserved; generic extraskeletal chondrosarcoma or panelNR4A3target list not automatically measuredEMC. All EMC donor/condition observations in eligible advancing sources and source controls retained, including baselineonly, unlinked, negative and adverse/disease-progressive states.
assay_gate: A tumor-informed molecular target demonstrably present in the same donor tumor, or independently established tumor-specific analyte; totalcfDNA/CRP/albumin/routinebloodmarkers not tumor-specific by label
At least two source-linked conditions with actual disease change or a meaningful timing contrast; source burden metric/unit/time and bloodsample timing relative to treatment declared
Sample-specific analyte unit, assay coverage/input/LOD and technical control sufficient to interpret detection/nondetection; no inferred threshold from one observed detection
Matched normalbloodcell/CH or other tumor-origin controls where relevant; DNAnegative without an assayed known target not absent shedding
Lesions/draws/technicalreplicates are conditions, not independent donors; donor overlap and earlier/later reports explicit
useful_conditional_endpoint: A prospectively specified, donor-level discordance/concordance of tumor-specific measurements with measured burden through actual change, explaining an experimental measurement requirement beyond known cfDNA confounding; no optimized threshold or therapy prediction. Numerical statistic/controls must be source-supported and separately frozen by owner before values.
strongest_alternatives: Published authors already report the exact serial relation or decline
Normal-cell DNA change from surgery/inflammation/preanalytics rather than tumor burden
Target coverage/input/sampleLOD or clonalhematopoiesis confounds nondetection/detection
Source identity discrepancy, posthoc sample-to-histology crosswalk or cohort/donor duplication
No independent serial native EMC replication or clinically meaningful measurement addition
defeat: No authenticated public case-linked serial tumor-specific data/timing/burden, no interpretable detectability controls, source already answers same contrast, aggregate/figure-only/reconstructed values, or suitable accessible public observations remain pending. This defeats the current proposed stage, not EMC shedding biology.
no_rescue: A diagnostic matrix without serial conditions is a separate scientific question requiring a dated before-values rationale and controls; it is not automatic rescue. No normal-cell marker repackaged as tumor-specific.
limits: Finite15minute focused review once owner files available; no whole-paper review, case biomarker values/images/UI/new downloads, denied tumorformation/topology/glycan/hyaluronic/FAP/HLA sources/fields, spend/outreach/publication/rootmutation/push. Keep >=10GiBfree and original freezes unchanged. Codex author and committer.
